proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord + passive_grant family
proposed_widenings.justification: No MagicItemRecord exists in UnitRecord. The surface union only has SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord. Magic items need a top-level record kind ('magic_item') and a mechanics family for always-on passive effects ('passive_grant' or equivalent). The brooch grants two permanent effects while worn — no activation, no trigger, no casting time.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While wearing this brooch, you have Resistance to Force damage, and you have Immunity to damage from the Magic Missile spell.

proposed_widenings.name: attunement surface field on MagicItemRecord
proposed_widenings.justification: Items requiring attunement need a field (or attunement_slot resource reference) on the record. The v4 taxonomy has 'attunement_slot' as a resource atom, but there is no surface field or mechanics family to express it.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_immunity effect variant (named-source immunity)
proposed_widenings.justification: The brooch grants Immunity to damage specifically from Magic Missile — not general Force immunity and not a reaction-triggered negate. The existing negate_named_effect atom lives inside TriggeredReactionMechanics.effects and requires a reaction cast. A passive named-source immunity is mechanically distinct and needs a new effect variant or a surface path to negate_named_effect from a passive_grant context.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you have Immunity to damage from the Magic Missile spell

notes: The two atomic effects (grant_resistance:force, negate_named_effect:magic_missile/damage_only) both have v4 atom analogs. The gap is entirely structural: no MagicItemRecord in UnitRecord, no passive_grant mechanics family, and no attunement surface field. Once MagicItemRecord + passive_grant are added, this unit should encode cleanly.
